layer: Time to every category (min) · Zero-wait transit
description: Zero-wait Tisséo scenario. Preserve walking access/egress, boarding and alighting permissions, scheduled running times, dwell while staying aboard, and walking or minimum transfer times. Assume immediate boarding at every leg. Route each of the two service dates separately and take the fastest result for each category across both dates and walking. The map shows the longest of these nine independent trips. This is an optimistic scenario without a fixed departure clock. The first walk to a boarding stop follows the full prepared pedestrian graph. Inferred walking transfers between stops are limited to 15 minutes.
